title: A stack batch keeps its shape after the Foreman's compactions
summary: Spec v6, batch-30 on top of CR-428/430/431: asks refuses a per-CR ready-to-merge in a stack batch while another chain CR has an open PR or a stacked CR is open; --outside-stack needs an open order on the CR; shape line points to foreman-stack.md; CoS sends mismatched asks back.
